text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Alex Henderson said Wednesday he was cutting his estimates for Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co for the 1997 and 1998 fiscal years.
-- The 1997 estimate was cut to $4.00 per share from $4.10
-- The 1998 estimate was cut to $4.50 per share from $4.60
-- The hold rating was maintained on 3M's stock

-- Henderson cited 3M's second-quarter earnings, which came in at $1.01 per share below estimates of about $1.04 per share. The quarter included a gain of $20 million, or $0.03 per share, which had not been counted on in forecasts, Henderson said.
"It managed their earnings up by three cents," he said.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610))
